WordPress portfolio demos

Four fictional businesses built in WordPress, exported as static copies. All names, people, addresses and phone numbers are made up.

  • Saltline Kayak Tours

    Block theme (Twenty Twenty-Five child), Yoast SEO, Contact Form 7, LocalBusiness and TouristTrip schema.

  • Harbor & Pine Law

    Elementor (free) with a mobile-first intake form. Compare with the unoptimized first build: Lighthouse mobile performance 81 to 99 on the Family law page.

  • Fernwood Makers

    Custom post type directory with search and filters that work on a static host, plus a Google Sheets import path.

  • Lantern Hill Roasters (WooCommerce)

    A coffee roaster's store: catalog, product pages with size and grind options, and a build-your-own 3-item bundle. Catalog, product pages and bundle builder work here; cart and checkout run for real in the Playground link (offline test gateway, no payment taken).

  • Sample WordPress Health Check report

    A nine-page client report (speed, Core Web Vitals, security, SEO, accessibility, maintenance) with a before and after measured on the Harbor & Pine demo. Every figure comes from the saved Lighthouse reports.
